name: Itazura 0 -Zero-
source:
Showa era with economic growth blooming after the war. Railways start to stretch around the towns. In the time of great change crimes also undergo a metamorphosis. Molester. Delinquents disappeared from the night town streets and moved to the trains as there was enclosed space and no police around. It seemed like a heaven for molesters ... However….

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
战后经济蓬勃发展的昭和时代。铁路开始延伸到城镇周围。在大变革的时代，犯罪也发生了变化。性骚扰者。由于空间封闭且周围没有警察，罪犯从夜晚的城镇街道上消失，并转移到火车上。这似乎是性骚扰者的天堂……然而……。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
